name: Dark Artist Scholar Archetype
body:
Associated Skill Disguise (Cha)

Basic Study Ability
Dark Knowledge (Ex)

You gain Psychic Sensitivity as a bonus feat. In addition, choose any three knacks (0-level psychic spells) available to the mesmerist class.

You can use these knacks, in any combination, a total of three times per day as spell-like abilities. Any save DCs are Charisma-based.

Associated Technique
Dread Technique (Ex)

A creature becomes uneasy when targeted by you, taking a –1 penalty to saving throws against fear effects.

At 4th level and every 4 levels thereafter, this penalty increases by 1, to a maximum of –6 at 20th level. The target must have line of sight to you and be able to clearly perceive you in order for this penalty to take effect.

Advanced Study Abilities
Dark Mind (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Dark Knowledge study ability, scholar level 2nd.

Intimidate becomes a class skill for you, and you can use inspiration for free with this skill. You can also use inspiration for free on any saving throw against a mind-affecting effect.

Dark Physique (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Dark Knowledge study ability, Disguise 5 ranks, scholar level 5th.

If you are struck by a critical hit or an attack that deals precision damage (such as a sneak attack), you have a 25% chance of ignoring the additional damage from that attack. If you are at least a 10th level shrouded master with 10 ranks in Disguise, this rises to a 50% chance. If you are at least a 15th level shrouded master with 15 ranks in Disguise, this rises to a 75% chance. This does not stack with other effects that reduce the chance of ignoring a critical hit or precision damage, such as the fortification armor special ability.

Dark Secrets (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Dark Knowledge study ability, scholar level 3rd.

By expending 1 point of inspiration, you can use dancing darkness as a spell-like ability. When you reach 7 ranks in Disguise, you can expend 2 points of inspiration to use darkness as a spell-like ability. When you reach 11 ranks in Disguise, you can expend 3 points of inspiration to use shifting shadows as a spell-like ability. When you reach 15 ranks in Disguise, you can expend 4 points of inspiration to use shadow conjuration as a spell-like ability.

Dark Senses (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Dark Knowledge study ability, scholar level 2nd.

You gain Blind-Fight as a bonus feat. When you obtain 7 ranks in Disguise, you also gain the Improved Blind-Fight feat. When you reach 12 ranks, you also gain blindsense 30 feet.
